card.name: Cognitive and psychomotor test wording
card.fires_on: Words inside phrases about mental and motor performance testing, such as divided attention, psychomotor performance, motor skills and Digit Symbol Substitution Test. Seen mostly in sedative or alcohol interaction text.

modes.label: Attention and performance tests
modes.description: Words in named cognitive tests like divided attention or the digit symbol test.
modes.example: the variability component of the<< divided>> attention test for 2.5 hours

modes.label: Psychomotor impairment phrases
modes.description: Final word of phrases about impaired psychomotor performance or mental and motor skills, often with alcohol.
modes.example: co-administration of QUVIVIQ with alcohol resulted in additive effects on psychomotor<< performance>> [see Drug Interactions (7.
